newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's tourism receipts up 17.9 pct in Jan-Nov.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's tourism receipts up 17.9 pct in Jan-Nov.

text.p: Morocco's tourism receipts rose 17.9 percent to 10.8 billion dirhams ($1.14 billion) in the 11 months to November 1996 from 9.18 billion in the same 1995 period, Morocco's trade regulatory body said on Monday.
It said earnings from foreign tourists accounted for six billion dirhams of receipts compared to 4.6 billion dirhams for the same period.
Expatriate remittances, which are the top currency earner totalled 16 billion dirhams against 15.2 billion dirhams for the same period. ($=9.4 dirhams)
